title: TikTok 1: Where your $5 coffee money actually goes (Kurzfassung)

lines.text: You pay five dollars for a coffee.
Beans, milk and the cup are only a small slice.
Rent for a busy corner is often the biggest cost.
Staff, taxes and training take another big slice.
Power, the machine and card fees add up too.
What is left is profit. Only a few cents.
So you pay for the corner, the people and the time.
Which part do you think costs the most?
